description:
Photograph a receipt. The merchant, amount, date and category are read on your iPhone, and that is the end of it — nothing is uploaded, because the app makes no network calls at all.

WHAT IT DOES
• Scans through Apple's document camera, which straightens the receipt and fixes contrast before the text is read
• Reads on-device with Apple's Vision framework, in your phone's language
• Sorts spending by category — groceries, dining, transport — from the merchant
• Monthly totals, charts and a weekly trend
• Search across everything you have scanned
• PDF export when you need to hand the month to someone

WORKS WITHOUT A NETWORK
Put the phone in airplane mode and nothing changes. There is no server to reach, no account to create, no subscription to forget about. Your receipts are on your phone, and if you use iCloud, in your own iCloud account.

WHAT IS NOT IN IT
No analytics. No crash reporter. No advertising identifier. No third-party SDK of any kind. Nothing to opt out of, because there is nothing collecting.

CURRENCIES AND LANGUAGES
Reads receipts in Turkish, Russian, English, German, French, Spanish and Italian, and recognises the currency from the receipt itself — TL, EUR, USD, RUB and the usual symbols — rather than assuming dollars.

Free, and it stays free.
promotionalText: Scan a receipt, keep the number. Reads on your iPhone, uploads nothing, costs nothing.
